findings.description: Critical: skills/autopilot/scripts/convergence_loop.py:429 and skills/merge-pull-requests/scripts/vendor_review.py:309 call dispatch_and_wait() without phase/routing_resolver/routing_context. With resolver=None, resolve_review_routing immediately returns static fallback (null model), so production reviews never apply the reviewer archetype / premium mapping required by agent-archetypes (e.g. Pi reviewer/premium). Routing is only exercised by unit tests that inject a resolver.
findings.resolution: Wire a default reviewer-archetype resolver into ReviewOrchestrator for review-mode (explicit > phase > default reviewer > static-on-failure), and pass phase/resolver from converge() and PR review so premium model/thinking actually reach CLI/SDK/async attempts.

findings.description: Critical: skills/parallel-infrastructure/scripts/review_dispatcher.py:53 defines ErrorClass.AUTH='auth_required', but _result_response (1547-1551) only accepts contract enum value 'auth'. Auth failures are rewritten to error_class='unknown', so terminal_outcome becomes 'unknown' instead of the required 'auth' and auth provenance is lost for recovery/quorum diagnostics.
findings.resolution: Map ErrorClass.AUTH to contract value 'auth' (or change the enum value) before recovery recording; add a regression asserting auth classification remains terminal with terminal_outcome='auth'.

findings.description: Critical: skills/parallel-infrastructure/scripts/review_attempts.py:140 defines select_replacement_vendor and attempt-chain validation accepts reason=replacement_vendor, but review_dispatcher never runs a replacement-vendor chain after invalid_output/capacity exhaustion, never transfers/cancels the replacement's original logical slot, and never records allocation in the round manifest. Spec scenarios for replacement success, no-double-vote, and unavailable replacement are unimplemented on the production path.
findings.resolution: After vendor-local exhaustion, select at most one not-yet-dispatched replacement in configured order, cancel/transfer its primary slot before dispatch, run the same bounded chain, and count at most one quorum unit per distinct vendor.

findings.description: Critical: skills/parallel-infrastructure/scripts/consensus_synthesizer.py:307-337 builds groups with union-find over all edges ≥ threshold. Location chain A↔B and B↔C merges A+B+C even when A does not match C (reproduced: one group of 3). Spec requires description-only grouping to admit members only when they match the anchor and every existing member, forbidding weak A-B/B-C transitive bridges; over-grouping can also attach a future adjudication to unrelated concerns.
findings.resolution: Replace connected-component union with deterministic clique/anchor admission (especially for description-only edges) so A is not placed with C unless score(A,C) meets threshold against every group member; add the weak-transitive regression fixture.

findings.description: Critical: validate_consensus_report() is required by skill-workflow (alias equality, nested/flat quorum invariants, false-quorum rejection) and design D7, but no such function exists. consensus_synthesizer.to_dict writes revision-2 fields and write_report/convergence persist without relational validation, so malformed or aliased-disagreeing reports are not fail-closed.
findings.resolution: Implement validate_consensus_report() enforcing provisional↔unconfirmed, blocking_count==effective_blocking_count, provisional_count==unconfirmed_count, received≤requested, received==len(eligible_vendors), met==(received≥minimum_required), and call it before every persistence/convergence decision.

findings.description: Critical: skills/parallel-infrastructure/scripts/consensus_synthesizer.py:387 always evaluates adjudication={'status':'unreviewed'} and to_dict always emits applied_adjudications=[] (487). There is no ledger parameter, fingerprint matching, stale rejection, or trusted accepted_risk resolver. Evidence-backed fixed/false_positive/accepted_risk and deferred tracking requirements cannot be applied by synthesis, so convergence cannot clear blockers via adjudication as specified.
findings.resolution: Accept an atomically loaded adjudication ledger keyed by group_id + sorted concern fingerprints; validate evidence/authorization (trusted human resolver for accepted_risk); reject unknown/stale entries fail-closed; emit applied_adjudications; re-run evaluate_blocking with validated adjudication.

findings.description: High: skills/parallel-infrastructure/scripts/consensus_synthesizer.py:198-199 still hard-fails match_score when a.type != b.type, so exact same-location findings with compatible type-family differences never group. Design D3 and the deterministic-match requirement state exact location may cross type-family boundaries (taxonomy lowers confidence but is not an absolute veto).
findings.resolution: Allow structured location matches across configured type aliases/families with reduced score; keep type identity as a boost rather than a hard prerequisite for location edges.

findings.description: High: skills/parallel-infrastructure/scripts/consensus_synthesizer.py:451-458 sets every source_findings[].concern_fingerprint to the group_id hash rather than a per-finding normalized concern fingerprint. Spec/ledger require entries keyed by group_id and exact sorted concern fingerprints; identical fingerprints destroy stale-regroup detection and make ledger attach/reject semantics non-auditable.
findings.resolution: Compute stable per-finding concern fingerprints from normalized location/type/description evidence; derive group_id from the sorted fingerprint set; store those fingerprints in source_findings and ledger entries.

findings.description: High: Matcher never enforces the required pre-match input limits (≤500 findings and ≤2 MiB parsed output per vendor). Oversized vendor results can force quadratic pairwise work in _match_all (324+) instead of being classified invalid_output before matching.
findings.resolution: Before matching, reject vendor results exceeding 500 findings or 2 MiB of parsed output as invalid_output and skip unbounded pairwise comparison.

findings.description: High: skills/parallel-infrastructure/scripts/review_dispatcher.py:1695 treats any non-null routing.thinking as configuration_failure for SDK, ignoring SdkConfig.thinking_parameter/thinking_values loaded from agents.yaml (1295-1296, 166-167). Agent-archetypes requires CLI/SDK/async to apply resolved thinking via provider configuration; codex SDK config declares thinking_parameter but is never used.
findings.resolution: Translate SDK thinking via thinking_parameter/thinking_values (or fail only when translation is unsupported); pass applied values into _call_sdk paths and record thinking_translation provenance.

findings.description: High: skills/parallel-infrastructure/scripts/review_dispatcher.py:1926-1946 write_manifest still serializes legacy success-only dispatches and sets quorum_received=sum(r.success), dropping attempt chains and shared is_quorum_eligible. Spec requires dispatch metadata retain the complete bounded attempt chain and quorum_received from the shared predicate.
findings.resolution: Persist full logical-result payloads (or equivalent attempt chains) in dispatches[] and compute quorum_received via is_quorum_eligible / quorum_summary, matching convergence_loop checkpointing.

findings.description: High: skills/autopilot/scripts/convergence_loop.py:533-537 escalates whenever status=='disagreement', ignoring policy.convergence_blocking / adjudication. Spec says a valid non-blocking adjudication resolves the blocker without erasing historical disagreement; this path would still escalate after fixed/false_positive/accepted_risk once the ledger exists.
findings.resolution: Escalate only when disagreement remains convergence-blocking (or summary.convergence_blocking_count > 0 / unresolved disagreement policy), not merely because status still records historical disagreement.

findings.description: High: skills/parallel-infrastructure/scripts/consensus_policy.py:27-36 accepts accepted_risk when authorization has actor_type=='human' plus actor_id/approval_ref strings. Spec requires only a trusted human approval resolver (coordinator_audit/github_approval/signed_local_record) and rejection of fabricated actor strings without a trusted approval record; schema mechanism/authorized_at fields are not checked.
findings.resolution: Validate accepted_risk only through a trusted approval resolver that verifies mechanism, approval_ref, and authorization integrity; reject synthesizer/vendor-supplied actor-only waivers.

findings.description: High: Design/spec require progressive terminal persistence as each vendor finishes (so a slow/timed-out vendor cannot hide later state). review_dispatcher.dispatch_and_wait still collects all results in-memory (1789+) and convergence checkpoints only after the full sequential loop (convergence_loop.py:441+). Whole-chain timeout with later-vendor continuation is present at process level, but intermediate terminal artifacts are not durably written per vendor.
findings.resolution: After each vendor reaches a terminal logical result, immediately append/persist the attempt chain and vendor index entry before starting the next vendor.

findings.description: Nit: Deterministic structured matching (type-family aliases, synonym map, location/symbol/requirement bucketing, algorithm version provenance beyond a constant string) is largely absent. match_score remains the prior type-gated lexical scorer; algorithm_version is hard-coded 'structured-v1' without structured evidence objects. Spec D3 scenarios for taxonomy aliases and structured-first evidence are only partially met by order-sorted union-find.
findings.resolution: Implement structured candidate bucketing, owned type aliases/synonyms, and rich match evidence (method/score/evidence tokens) before description similarity, with versioned algorithm metadata.

findings.description: none: Fail-closed core policy is correctly implemented for unadjudicated findings: evaluate_blocking treats provisional medium+ fix/regenerate/escalate as convergence-blocking; synthesizer preserves source dispositions; summary aliases set blocking_count==effective_blocking_count and provisional_count==unconfirmed_count; convergence_loop no longer relaxes unconfirmed findings in the final round and returns max_rounds with escalate_findings.
findings.resolution: No change required for this observation; keep regressions for false-zero and final-round blockers.

findings.description: none: Bounded vendor-local recovery for invalid_output (initial → one corrective → deduped model fallbacks under one monotonic deadline), capacity skip of corrective, auth non-retry (once class mapping is fixed), sanitize_diagnostic redaction/truncation, and shared is_quorum_eligible for empty schema-valid findings are present and covered by attempt-core tests.
findings.resolution: No change required for this observation; extend the same invariants to replacement-vendor wiring and dispatcher manifests.
